a_FRI_FPI_vs_CFRS.note: FRI/FPI higher = better, so negative tau = agreement; both are functions of the same cone inputs (consistency check).

b_faa_tables.note: Pairs are across polymers (no within-paper control); single small-scale index vs UL-94 class.

ar0153_epoxies.note: OSU pHRR (30-144 kW/m2) is mostly below the cone pHRR range (75-1300), so its subscore saturates at 0; no TTI/avg_HRR.

MIL-STD-2031(SH).criteria: Navy submarine interior composites: flame spread (ASTM E162), smoke (ASTM E662), cone calorimeter (ASTM E1354) time to ignition, peak and average HRR and gas generation, at several fluxes up to 75-100 kW/m2, plus burn-through and larger scale tests. Pass/fail numbers could not be confirmed from an open copy in this search (not recorded here).
MIL-STD-2031(SH).why: Needs 75-100 kW/m2 cone data with smoke/gas; repo cone data is 25-65 kW/m2 (mostly 35/50), no smoke column used. No open per-material pass/fail table found.

FAA 14 CFR 25.853 / App. F Part IV.criteria: OSU heat release at 35 kW/m2 with pilot flame: peak HRR <= 65 kW/m2 and total heat release in first 2 min <= 65 kW-min/m2 (the '65/65' rule) for large cabin interior panels.
FAA 14 CFR 25.853 / App. F Part IV.why: OSU pHRR/THR exist in data/v2/loi_faa_ar0153.csv for 9 epoxies, so 65/65 pass/fail could be derived (THR in kW-min/m2 over the full test, not the first 2 min, so only an upper bound on THR). Different apparatus from cone; not usable to score cone-based CFRS.

open_dataset_leads.name: DOPO-EP-ML (Huang, Zheng, Shi)
open_dataset_leads.carries: 599 epoxy records, 130 papers: UL-94 + LOI + cone pHRR (406) / THR (397) at 35 and 50 kW/m2; no TTI. Best candidate to enlarge D1 (check DOI overlap with the lit snapshot).

open_dataset_leads.name: IMDEA bio-FR PA56
open_dataset_leads.carries: 101 PA56 rows: LOI + cone pHRR/THR/TSP; no UL-94 and no TTI in the sheet; one paper (D2-type only).

open_dataset_leads.carries: Separate UL-94 (1041 rows) and LOI+TTI+pHRR+THR (383 rows) databases; descriptor-only, not linkable to a paper-level pairing.
